newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedbank seen in bid for Foreningsbanken.
newsitem.headline: Swedbank seen in bid for Foreningsbanken.

text.p: The decision to halt bourse trading in Swedish banks Swedbank and Foreningsbanken means that a long-awaited bid by Swedbank for Foreningsbanken is about to be made, Swedish bank analysts said on Monday.
Analysts said the bid may be hostile, although the two banks said in a statement published after the bourse announcement that they were discussing forms of a merger.
Foreningsbanken last June rejected any talk of closer cooperation with Swedbank -- known in Sweden as Sparbanken -- saying it would not be beneficial.
Foreningsbanken made the statement after Swedbank announced it had bought almost 5.0 percent of the rural bank's stock and had said a merger could be beneficial in the long term.
A large part of Foreningsbanken's client base is in the rural sector.
